name: Yuxin Yang
summary: Second-year Ph.D. student in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the University of California, Santa Cruz, advised by Prof. Yuanchao Xu. Research interests include secure memory systems, CXL-based memory disaggregation, trusted execution environments, learned indexes, and distributed file systems.

research.title: A resizing scheme for file systems
